messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: elevated 5xx (gateway errors) from private VPC egress in prod-us-west-2. Rolling error rate spike at 23% over baseline. Paging oncall. @gina_oncall #incidents :rotating_light:

gina_oncall: on it. looking at alert graph now. which customers impacted? any deploys?

carla_cs: customers A and B reported 504s for inference requests ~10m ago, support surfaced errors to infra.

frank_net: I'm seeing repeated TCP RSTs on the NAT gateway side and a flurry of retransmits out of the peering interface. traceroute to external model host drops after transit appliance.

ben_infra: no user-facing deploys in last 30m. autoscaler and runtime healthy. logs show gateway 502/504 from our egress gateway (gw-egress-1).

ops-automation-bot: deploy-bot: No recent rollout in prod-us-west-2. Metric-scan: spike started at 1767777600. Correlation: route-table change detected in tenant-vpc-17 at 1767777480 by cloud-controller (change id rt-cc-8432).

gina_oncall: frank, can you confirm NAT session churn? run `sudo conntrack -L | grep <model-ip>` on the transit appliance and `ip route get <model-ip>` on gw-egress-1

frank_net: output snippets:
```
# conntrack | grep 10.11.22.33
tcp      6 431999 ESTABLISHED src=10.11.5.12 dst=10.11.22.33 sport=54012 dport=443 packets=124 bytes=9842 [ASSURED] mark=0
tcp      6 179 TIME_WAIT src=10.11.5.12 dst=10.11.22.33 sport=54013 dport=443 packets=2 bytes=200
```
and `ip route get 10.11.22.33` on gw-egress-1 shows next-hop via transit-appliance-2, but on transit-appliance-2 the return path goes to transit-appliance-1 (asymmetric).

dinesh_runtime: that asymmetric path would blow our SNAT mappings when replies come from a different appliance. expecting 5xx when the connection doesn't match conntrack.

ben_infra: checking security groups — noticed a recent deny rule applied to sg-vpc-egress (managed by terraform change tf-2026-03-15-07). The rule denies ephemeral ports 32768-61000 from transit-appliances in peering range. That would break replies.

emma_ml: quick thought — are we falling back to lower-capacity model replicas across region because of routing? latency vs 5xx mix?

frank_net: confirmed: SG deny + route-table change = replies coming back to different NAT with no SNAT mapping -> RSTs/504s. Also saw `tcpdump` with `ICMP unreachable` for a subset.

gina_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily remove the deny rule on sg-vpc-egress (ben) 2) pin route-table back to previous state (ben) 3) rotate transit appliances to clear conntrack (frank) 4) notify customers and escalate if not resolved in 15m (carla).

ben_infra: rolling back terraform change now (apply in progress). will patch SG and route concurrently. ETA 6m. `terraform apply` output: https://infra-ops/changes/rt-cc-8432

ops-automation-bot: Change window: rollback applied to sg-vpc-egress (change id rollback-1767777790)

frank_net: starting conntrack flush on transit appliances (graceful): `sudo conntrack -F` on transit-appliance-{1,2}. Doing one at a time to avoid complete teardown.

dinesh_runtime: enabling fallback routing for gateway to use dedicated-donut-nat for 1m to reduce blast radius. patching route priority.

carla_cs: sending initial customer note: "We're investigating a networking issue causing intermittent 5xx for inference requests in us-west-2. Engineers are rolling a mitigation; we'll update in 15 minutes."

gina_oncall: monitoring logs and metrics. early signs: error rate dropping from 23% -> 8% after SG patch.

ben_infra: rollback completed, SG rule removed. route table restored to prev (rt-cc-8429).

frank_net: conntrack flush completed on transit-appliance-2, then 1. Observed existing TCP sessions recover. `tcpdump` shows SYN/ACK completing.

emma_ml: request-level telemetry shows success rate for model calls improving, latency stable.

gina_oncall: status update: gateways nominal, error rate back to baseline ~1.2%. keeping paging open for 30m for regression watch.

carla_cs: sending customer follow-up: "Issue mitigated — root cause: concurrent route table change + restrictive SG causing asymmetric return path and SNAT mismatch. We applied rollback and flushed NAT states. We're monitoring and will follow up with RCA."

dinesh_runtime: next steps: propose guardrail — block terraform route-table/sg changes that touch transit appliance paths during high-traffic windows, and add auto-detect to correlate route changes with NAT error spikes.

gina_oncall: agreed. filing incident ticket with timeline + action items. assigning postmortem to ben_infra + frank_net + dinesh_runtime.

ops-automation-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-17677777, severity: S2, assignees: ben_infra, frank_net, dinesh_runtime.

gina_oncall: closing paging for now. keep Slack thread for notes. :thumbsup:
